ommc.gui.title.configs: Oh My Minecraft Client - Config - Version: %s
config.comment.clearwaypoint: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r A hotkey to clear the highlighted waypoint.
config.comment.forceparsewaypointfromcha: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Force parsing waypoints from chat, overriding any existing click event.
config.comment.parsewaypointfromchat: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Parse waypoints from chat messages.
config.comment.dontclearchathistory: Save the chat messages to a file when leaving a world, and restore them the next time you join the same world. Saved separately per world (save / server), so histories never mix. Note: only the messages are saved, not the input history (the ones you scroll through with the up arrow).
config.comment.disableblocklistcheck: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Workaround for MC-218167: keep the network request from blocking the render thread.
config.comment.disablepistonpushentity: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Reduce piston lag (e.g. carpet duplicators) by preventing client-side pistons from pushing entities (except the player). May cause entity position rendering errors.
config.comment.highlightpersistentmob: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Highlight mobs that will not despawn. Limited by client-side data: currently only mobs holding special items or with custom names can be detected.
config.comment.highlightpersistentmobcli: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Use client-side data (held item, custom name) to decide whether a mob will despawn. May misjudge. Keep this off in singleplayer; on servers MasaGadget's syncAllEntityData can be used to sync entity data locally.
config.comment.worldeaterminehelper: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r When blocks listed in the World Eater Mine Helper Whitelist are exposed to air, the client renders a mirror image of them above, to help with world eater maintenance and mining.
config.comment.highlightentityblacklist: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Blacklist for the entity highlight feature.
config.comment.highlightentitylisttype: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Whether highlightEntityWhiteList/BlackList is treated as a whitelist or a blacklist.
config.comment.highlightentitywhitelist: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Whitelist for the entity highlight feature.
config.comment.worldeaterminehelperwhite: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Blocks that get the mirrored render while worldEaterMineHelper is enabled.
config.comment.blockmodelnooffsetblackli: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Blacklist for the block model no-offset feature.
config.comment.blockmodelnooffsetlisttyp: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Whether blockModelNoOffsetWhitelist/Blacklist is treated as a whitelist or a blacklist.
config.comment.blockmodelnooffsetwhiteli: §c[NOT IMPLEMENTED]§r Whitelist for the block model no-offset feature.
